newsitem.title: USA: ACE Ltd says signs Ockham deal.
newsitem.headline: ACE Ltd says signs Ockham deal.

text.p: ACE Ltd has signed a contract to acquire Ockham Worldwide Holdings Plc for a total of 19.5 million sterling in cash and loan notes, a company statement said Thursday.
The statement, issued from Hamilton, Bermuda, said ACE expected to close the deal before the end of November.
Ockham Worldwide is the subsidiary of Ockham Holdings Plc that owns two Lloyd's of London managing agencies.
The statement said ACE had agreed to provide funds at Lloyd's of up to 50 million sterling to support underwriting by Worldwide syndicates in 1997 and afterwards.
The purchase price would include 3.0 million sterling in cash, 13.5 million in interest-bearing cash, collateralized loan notes, and 3.0 million in interest-bearing loan notes, it said.
The statement said Ockham was holding its right to profit commission for the 1994 and 1995 years of account.
ACE specializes in catastrophe insurance for a diverse group of international clients.
